picks.thesis: Day 2 of the 10-22 good-news gap: record $292B backlog, 2026 EPS guide raised to $30.35-30.75 and FCF to $7.8-8.0B; Brent at a five-month high on Gulf attacks supports missile-defense demand. It held +5-7% through a -2.7% Nasdaq day but stayed below VWAP, so enter only if it now trades above VWAP. Wrong if below ~$575.
